questions.question: Does the plan name the exact reported symptom?

criteria.yes: The plan names the reported symptom.
criteria.no: The plan names a different or vague symptom.

questions.question: Does the plan use a bounded reproduction command?

criteria.yes: One command asserts the symptom within a stated bound.
criteria.no: The command is absent or unbounded.

questions.question: Does the plan rank falsifiable causes?

criteria.yes: Causes are ranked with testable predictions.

questions.question: Does the plan keep regression RED before the patch?

criteria.yes: The regression fails before any patch.
criteria.no: The patch precedes RED or no regression exists.

questions.question: Does the plan withhold an unverified performance verdict?

criteria.yes: An unequal workload withholds the verdict.
criteria.no: The plan claims an improvement from unequal runs.

questions.question: Does the plan record environment controls?

criteria.yes: Inputs, seed, time, or network controls are recorded.

questions.question: Does the plan minimize the failing reproduction?

criteria.yes: The plan reduces the case while the symptom remains.
criteria.no: The plan keeps an unreduced case.

questions.question: Does the plan remove temporary instrumentation?
Does the plan verify the original reproduction after the fix?

criteria.yes: The original case is rerun after the fix.
criteria.no: Only the new test is rerun.

questions.question: Does the plan state what remains uncertain?
